## Omnicom Forms Omnicom Brazil, Led by Filipe Bartholomeu


November 24, 2026


*New leadership structure will increase business opportunities and connect core disciplines across creativity, media, data, and technology*


São Paulo, November 24, 2026 – Omnicom (NYSE: OMC), the world’s leading marketing and sales company, today announced the formation of Omnicom Brazil, which will bring Omnicom’s operations across the country under one leadership structure. Filipe Bartholomeu, who previously served as Partner and CEO of AlmapBBDO and Executive President of BBDO Brazil, will lead Omnicom Brazil as CEO.


This new structure expands Omnicom’s capabilities in one of the world’s largest communications markets. It will further strengthen integration across multiple areas of expertise and allow the development of increasingly comprehensive solutions to help clients solve their most critical business issues and drive growth.


At the helm of this structure, Bartholomeu will be responsible for shaping the group’s business strategy, developing its operations, guiding investment decisions, and identifying further opportunities for cross-company collaboration and integration.


“Brazil is a major market for Omnicom, with companies that lead in their fields and huge potential for growth. This new leadership structure reflects our drive to cement the group’s footprint and increase our capacity to generate value for our clients. Creativity drives growth for our clients’ businesses, and Filipe has proven to drive creativity. Under his leadership AlmapBBDO has been consistently recognized as one of the world’s most creative agencies. He has a track record of developing talent, growing business, and delivering results, making him a great choice to lead this new chapter of Omnicom Brazil,” said John Wren, Chairman and CEO of Omnicom.


Omnicom Brazil encompasses companies that work across advertising, media, CRM, shopper, technology and data.


Under this new leadership structure, agencies within the market will continue to operate under their existing brands, retain their own cultures, and produce work in line with their expertise, while benefiting from shared talent, knowledge, and resources across the group, strengthening their competitive position.


“We have extraordinary companies, strong brands, and a roster of talent beyond compare. Omnicom Brazil’s role is to make the most of that strength while respecting the capabilities of each operation, all while creating new growth opportunities for our clients. Creativity will be at the heart of this transformation, powered by Omni and its leading data, identity and AI capabilities,” said Bartholomeu.


**About Omnicom**


Omnicom (NYSE: OMC) is the world’s leading marketing and sales company. Powered by Omni, its proprietary data and identity platform, Omnicom’s Connected Capabilities unite the company’s agency brands, talent, and domain expertise across media, commerce, consulting, precision marketing, advertising, production, health, public relations, branding, and experiential to address clients’ most critical growth priorities. For more information, visit[www.omc.com](https://www.omc.com/) .
